The elevated white blood cell count and C-reactive protein level also support this diagnosis. The abdominal CT scan showing a swollen and thickened tubular structure at the cecal pole with a pericecal collection is consistent with appendicitis.
Cecal volvulus: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings, including the swollen tubular structure at the cecal pole and pericecal collection, could also be consistent with cecal volvulus. The patient's history of laparoscopic appendectomy may also increase the risk of this condition.
